title: contact_import.finished
description: Published by contacts when an import reaches a final status (data model §8 and §10; task 6.2): completed, completed with errors, failed, cancelled, or expired because the file was never uploaded. The file and its error report are deleted at delete_after. No file name, number or row data appears here. This is the envelope's data field, not the whole envelope (see platform/events.Envelope).

rows_total.description: Data rows read, blank ones included; 0 when the file was never read.

error_code.description: Why a failed import failed, a catalogue code: VAL-4007 not CSV or XLSX, VAL-4008 too large or empty, VAL-4009 malware, VAL-4022 unreadable or no number column.

delete_after.description: When the file and its error report are deleted.
